results.scope: Known synthetic kernel queries with a shared convex response-surface learner. Held-out true kernels enter scoring only. Formal certificates compare estimated full and reduced kernels, not the unknown generating environment response. No human inference.
results.controls_scope: All controls within a search method receive the same queried kernels. Random-capacity control matches targeted state count. Identity isolates environment-model error. All-observed refinement uses the full available query set; random-witness control uses one uniformly selected observed environment.
